status: Implemented in an isolated review candidate; not published
summary: Short additional How to Obtain lines in the shared item-information projection. Bean Sprouts and related fermented ingredients explain worker workshops; crops explain starter seeds and applicable grade exchanges. Other reviewed additions cover gathering, farming, material exchanges, workshop equipment, documented monster sources and rare Cooking outputs with their minimum skill.
behavior: All existing item-reference hosts consume the same projection. Existing theme-adaptive layout, copy actions, recipe tabs, source pills and scrolling are unchanged.
Require both exact item ID and normalized canonical name; do not transfer replacement-item facts to legacy aliases, a different grade or an unresolved ID.
Market supplements require positive native marketability, exact current catalog name/ID agreement and current exclusions. Preserve existing richer restrictions; market eligibility is not live stock.

Special Cooking source text requires an explicit native description, exact output name and matching existing recipe or special-output mapping. Preserve rare chance and the documented minimum skill; no proc-rate calculation changes.
Retain region, tool, quantity and other qualifications. Milk's existing long instruction is shortened, retaining its 10 Energy cost, without a duplicate milking line.
Do not modify app-data.json, worker/fishing maps, calculations, grade decisions, vendor prices, exchange logic, market broker, profiles, storage contract or lifecycle safeguards.
